Plugin.Name: ZFS Director
Plugin.Overview:
ZFS Director brings dataset and snapshot management, a Snapshot File Manager, Sanoid snapshot policies and Syncoid replication into the Unraid WebGUI.
Browse snapshots, restore selected files, prepare ZIP archives and convert directories to datasets. Follow operations, progress, errors and recovery in Jobs. Workspace and Compact layouts support Black, Gray, White, Azure and the inherited Unraid theme.
Tested on Unraid 7.3.3 with OpenZFS 2.4.4. Sanoid/Syncoid is optional, installed separately and OFF on a fresh configuration. Existing settings and external schedules are preserved.
Developed and maintained by d1-m4ss, based on ZFS Master, using AI-assisted coding tools.
